title: Coach
summary: An AI coach that reads the diary, remembers, and speaks up when it matters.
description: The coach is a chat on the Coach tab. Its knowledge is kept in separate pieces: the stance the user declares, the memory it keeps, manuals it writes, and a digest of the diary computed fresh every turn.

stories.as: someone trying to change a habit
stories.want: a coach that already knows how my week went
stories.soThat: I can ask it a question without explaining myself first

requirements.text: The stance (ranked imperatives, tone, subjects never to raise) is set by the user and never edited by the coach.
The coach's memory (commitments, preferences, notes) is kept apart from chats: deleting a chat keeps it, and a new chat starts with it.
Every coach turn carries a digest of the diary computed at that moment.
A conversation has its own address, `/assistant/<chatId>`.
An entity id the coach writes in a message shows as a chip with that entity's title, opening its page.
Coach tools take ids in TypeID form and also accept the bare UUIDs and numbers older chats quote; an id of the wrong kind is refused with the reason.
The coach never reads a bare "calories": every calorie figure it can query has one name (eaten, burned_workouts, burned_total, target, net, remaining, energy_balance).
The memory is shown on a page the user can read.
